structure.title: Structure of track work
structure.subtitle: Four steps — that’s how the job works. Keep the order.
structure.step1Text: Always contact Fdl first. Give track, section (km) and type of work. Only enter track after clearance (Freigabe).
structure.step2Text: Depending on visibility (min. 500 m) and track type: V11, UV-Sperrung or Annäherungsstrecke. The decision tree helps.
structure.step3Text: Work only in the cleared area. High-vis, helmet, sturdy shoes. Know your escape route (Rückweiche). Stay focused.
structure.step4Text: When finished, report LÜ-Sendung to Fdl. Track is open again only after Fdl clearance.
structure.footer: Next: use the sections below. Start with terminology and rules.
